clues.text: Standing 100 feet tall, this hybrid coaster reaches a top speed of 53 mph and flips riders through 3 inversions.
Constructed by Rocky Mountain Construction (RMC), this hybrid coaster officially opened to riders in 2016.
This coaster can be found in the state of California, thrilling visitors in the city of Vallejo.
Built on an existing wooden support structure, this hybrid coaster debuted a brand-new inversion element described as a 'step-up under-flip inverted roll.'
This coaster shares its name with the iconic comic book supervillain widely known from the Batman stories in DC Comics.

evidence.quote: The Joker is a steel roller coaster at Six Flags Discovery Kingdom in Vallejo, California.

The wood-steel hybrid was designed to incorporate three inversions, including a new element described as a "step-up under-flip inverted roll", and it also received new trains themed to the Joker comic book character.
The Joker's trains are themed to the character widely known in the Batman comics.
